pairs.target: nài lěi de kǒuxìn sòngdào shí , tǎ wéi zhèng hé yīwén zhēng yìtiáo hé gāi tú duō kuān .
pairs.english: When Nerai's message arrived, Tavi and Iven were arguing over how wide to colour a river.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的口信送到时，塔维正和伊文争一条河该涂多宽。

pairs.target: " tú dé xiàng miàntiáo . " yīwén shuō . " hé yě yǒu zhǎi de . "
pairs.english: “You've made it a noodle,” Iven said. “Rivers can be narrow.”
pairs.hanzi:
“涂得像面条。”伊文说。
“河也有窄的。”

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ tú zhuǎnguò qù , zài tāmen zhōngjiān huàchū yuángǎo shàng lòudiào de bǐlìchǐ .
pairs.english: Mira turned the drawing and drew in the scale missing from the original, between the two of them.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把图转过去，在他们中间划出原稿上漏掉的比例尺。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu bù shuōhuà le .
pairs.english: Both fell silent.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都不说话了。

pairs.target: lái chuánhuà de ménfáng xiào zhe qiāo le qiāomén .
pairs.english: The gatekeeper delivering the message knocked with a smile.
pairs.hanzi: 来传话的门房笑着敲了敲门。

pairs.target: hòutiān xiàwǔ , shuǐlù gōngshǔ yào yì běi chà huò lù de jǐgè gǎi fǎ ,
pairs.english: The afternoon after tomorrow, the waterways office would discuss several revisions to the Northfork freight route;
pairs.hanzi: 后天下午，水路公署要议北汊货路的几个改法，

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn tāmen shìfǒu yuànyì pángtīng .
pairs.english: Nerai wondered whether they'd like to observe.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问他们是否愿意旁听。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī yǐjīng dāying dài xuéshēng guòqù , míngdān hái méi jiāo , qùbuqù dōu bù yǐngxiǎng kèyè .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian had agreed to bring students, but hadn't submitted the list yet; attendance wouldn't affect their studies.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师已经答应带学生过去，名单还没交，去不去都不影响课业。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu mǎshàng dāying .
pairs.english: Iven didn't agree immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有马上答应。

pairs.target: děng ménfáng zǒu le , tā cái shuō fùqīn yě huì zài .
pairs.english: Only when the gatekeeper left did he say his father would be there too.
pairs.hanzi: 等门房走了，他才说父亲也会在。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào nà suànbusuàn yícì xiánxiá lǐ de yāoqǐng .
pairs.english: He wasn't sure whether that counted as an invitation for his free time.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道那算不算一次闲暇里的邀请。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ wènwèn . " mǐlā shuō , " wǒ xiǎng kàn tāmen zěnme huà zhuǎnchē de dìfāng . "
pairs.english: “Then ask,” Mira said. “I want to see how they draw the turning ground.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你问问。”米拉说，“我想看他们怎么画转车的地方。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiǎng qù .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to go too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也想去。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngdào nà chù bèi tú shàng yígè kòngbái tūndiào de liàng wǎng chǎng ,
pairs.english: He thought of the net-drying ground swallowed by a blank on the map,
pairs.hanzi: 他想到那处被图上一个空白吞掉的晾网场，

pairs.target: xiǎng zhīdào yìqún cóngwèi zài nàlǐ shàiguò wǎng de rén , huì zěnyàng tán nà kuài dì .
pairs.english: wondering how people who had never dried nets there would discuss it.
pairs.hanzi: 想知道一群从未在那里晒过网的人，会怎样谈那块地。

pairs.target: liǎngtiān hòu , sāngè rén gēnzhe jiǎn lǎoshī zǒujìn gōngshǔ cètīng .
pairs.english: Two days later, the three followed Instructor Jian into a side hall of the office.
pairs.hanzi: 两天后，三个人跟着简老师走进公署侧厅。

pairs.target: tīnglǐ méiyǒu tāmen xiǎngxiàng de chángzhuō , jǐzhāng ǎi zhuō pīnzàiyìqǐ ,
pairs.english: There was no long table as they'd imagined, only several low tables pushed together,
pairs.hanzi: 厅里没有他们想象的长桌，几张矮桌拼在一起，

pairs.target: túzhǐ yā zài chábēi hé mù zhènzhǐ xià .
pairs.english: with drawings held under cups of tea and wooden paperweights.
pairs.hanzi: 图纸压在茶杯和木镇纸下。

pairs.target: chuāng biān zuò zhe yígè chuānjiù duǎnguà de nǚrén , xiùkǒu yǒu xiū guò de wǎng jié .
pairs.english: By the window sat a woman in an old short jacket, with mended net-knots on the cuffs.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边坐着一个穿旧短褂的女人，袖口有修过的网结。

pairs.target: nài lěi tì tāmen jièshào : yǎ lì , cóng běi chà lái , wèi zìjiā hé línjūmen bǎ jǐchù zhuǎnwān de chǐcùn dàilái , yě yào tīngtīng zhè tàng yìshì .
pairs.english: Nerai introduced her: Yali, from Northfork, bringing measurements of several bends for her household and neighbours, and here to listen as well.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾替他们介绍：雅栗，从北汊来，为自家和邻居们把几处转弯的尺寸带来，也要听听这趟议事。

pairs.target: yǎ lì kàn le yìyǎn mǐlā de tú jiá , wèn tā shìbushì huì huà pō .
pairs.english: Yali glanced at Mira's drawing folder and asked whether she could draw slopes.
pairs.hanzi: 雅栗看了一眼米拉的图夹，问她是不是会画坡。

pairs.target: " huì liáng , hái méi huà guò nǐmen nàlǐ . " " nà jiù biétì wǒmen bǎ pō huà píng le . "
pairs.english: “I can measure them. I haven't drawn your place.” “Then don't flatten our slopes for us.”
pairs.hanzi:
“会量，还没画过你们那里。”
“那就别替我们把坡画平了。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bú zhòng , mǐlā què rènzhēn diǎn le tóu .
pairs.english: She didn't say it harshly, but Mira nodded seriously.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得不重，米拉却认真点了头。

pairs.target: yīwén de fùqīn cóng lìngyìbiān guòlái , bǎ sānzhāng pángtīng dèng nuó dào qiángbiān ,
pairs.english: Iven's father came from the other side and moved three observers' stools against the wall,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的父亲从另一边过来，把三张旁听凳挪到墙边，

pairs.target: suíhòujiùqù zhǎo lòu sòng de yíyè fèiyòng biǎo , méiyǒu gěi érzi lìng tiāo zuòwèi .
pairs.english: then went to find a missing costs sheet, without choosing his son a special seat.
pairs.hanzi: 随后就去找漏送的一页费用表，没有给儿子另挑座位。

pairs.target: zhēngdé zuì jiǔ de bìng búshì lù wǎng nǎbiān zǒu .
pairs.english: The longest argument wasn't about which way the road should go.
pairs.hanzi: 争得最久的并不是路往哪边走。

pairs.target: ràokāi liàng wǎng chǎng de xiàn , tú shàng yǐjīng huà le ;
pairs.english: The line around the net-drying yard was already on the drawing;
pairs.hanzi: 绕开晾网场的线，图上已经画了；

pairs.target: nán de shì chēduì cóng xiákǒu tōngguò yào duō děng duōshǎo shíchén , duō chūlái de bānyùn yóu shuí fùqián .
pairs.english: what mattered was how long caravans would wait at the narrow passage, and who would pay for extra handling.
pairs.hanzi: 难的是车队从狭口通过要多等多少时辰，多出来的搬运由谁付钱。

pairs.target: yígè huò xíng dàibiǎo shuō , guò le zhǎngshuǐ de yuèfèn , jiù bùnéng zǒng ná shài wǎng shuō shì .
pairs.english: A freight-firm representative said that once the high-water months passed, net-drying couldn't always be the objection.
pairs.hanzi: 一个货行代表说，过了涨水的月份，就不能总拿晒网说事。

pairs.target: yǎ lì zhàn qǐlái , bǎ liǎngzhāng dié zài yìqǐ de báozhǐ fēnkāi .
pairs.english: Yali stood and separated two thin sheets that had been laid together.
pairs.hanzi: 雅栗站起来，把两张叠在一起的薄纸分开。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn yìzhāng biāo zhe liàng wǎng , xiàmiàn yìzhāng shì bǔ chuán de wèizhì .
pairs.english: The top sheet marked net-drying; the lower showed the boat-repair area.
pairs.hanzi: 上面一张标着晾网，下面一张是补船的位置。

pairs.target: " shuǐ luò le , chuán cái yǒu dìfāng tuōshànglái bǔ .
pairs.english: “Only when the water falls is there room to haul boats out for repairs.”
pairs.hanzi: “水落了，船才有地方拖上来补。

pairs.target: búshì wǎng yì shōu , zhèlǐ jiù méi rén yòng le . "
pairs.english: “Taking in the nets doesn't mean nobody uses the place.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是网一收，这里就没人用了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò zhí le . tā xiānqián yě yǐwéi děng yígè jìjié guòqù , yěxǔ shìqíng jiù hǎobàn xiē .
pairs.english: Tavi sat straighter. He too had thought waiting for a season to pass might make things easier.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐直了。他先前也以为等一个季节过去，也许事情就好办些。

pairs.target: nài lěi yòng shǒuzhǐ yánzhe ràoxíng xiàn zǒu le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai traced the detour once with a finger.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾用手指沿着绕行线走了一遍。

pairs.target: tā bàochū yǐ liáng guò de pō duàn , bǎ wèi liáng de nà yìxiǎo jiéliú kōng .
pairs.english: She gave the measured slopes, leaving the small unmeasured stretch blank.
pairs.hanzi: 她报出已量过的坡段，把未量的那一小截留空。

pairs.target: yīwén de fùqīn wèn néng bunéng xiān yùn qīng huò , huò xíng de rén shuō xiǎochē yě yào rén tuī ,
pairs.english: Iven's father asked about carrying light freight first; the freight people replied that small carts still needed pushers.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的父亲问能不能先运轻货，货行的人说小车也要人推，

pairs.target: liǎngbiān shuō dào hòulái , dōu bǎ chá wàng liáng le .
pairs.english: As both sides talked on, everyone forgot the tea until it cooled.
pairs.hanzi: 两边说到后来，都把茶忘凉了。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī shìyì xuéshēng búyào jiē huà .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian signalled the students not to interrupt.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师示意学生不要接话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ chàdiǎn chūkǒu de zhǔyì yàn le huíqù : fēn zǎowǎn zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi swallowed the suggestion on his lips: separate morning and evening trips.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把差点出口的主意咽了回去：分早晚走。

pairs.target: tā zài tú jiǎo zhǎo le zhǎo , cái kànjiàn pángbiān yǐjīng xiě zhe zhège tíyì ,
pairs.english: Looking at a corner of the map, he found the suggestion already written there,
pairs.hanzi: 他在图角找了找，才看见旁边已经写着这个提议，

pairs.target: xiàmiàn tiān zhe yèlǐ xiákǒu wúrén zhàokàn , qīngzǎo jūmín tiāoshuǐ jīngguò de liǎngtiáo yìjiàn .
pairs.english: with two comments underneath: no night watch at the narrow passage, and residents carrying water through early in the morning.
pairs.hanzi: 下面添着夜里狭口无人照看、清早居民挑水经过的两条意见。

pairs.target: yìshì méiyǒu bǎ huò lù dìng xiàlái .
pairs.english: The meeting didn't settle the freight route.
pairs.hanzi: 议事没有把货路定下来。

pairs.target: zuìhòu zhī dìng le qù xiànchǎng hé liáng ràoxíng duàn de rén hé rìqī ,
pairs.english: In the end they fixed only the people and date for measuring the detour on site,
pairs.hanzi: 最后只定了去现场核量绕行段的人和日期，

pairs.target: fèiyòng lìng liè liǎngzhǒng , bùxǔ bǎ " dài yì " cādiào sòng qù zhāo huò .
pairs.english: with two cost options to be listed separately; “Under discussion” must not be erased before soliciting freight.
pairs.hanzi: 费用另列两种，不许把“待议”擦掉送去招货。

pairs.target: yīwén de fùqīn qīnshǒu bǎ nà liǎnggè zì miáo qīng .
pairs.english: Iven's father traced those two characters clearly himself.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的父亲亲手把那两个字描清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zhǎnshì rìqián nà jù " duǎnxiàn jiāng tōng ", zhèhuí shuí yě méi jiào yīwén qù tíxǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered “Short route opening soon” before the exhibition day; this time nobody had to ask Iven to remind him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起展示日前那句“短线将通”，这回谁也没叫伊文去提醒。

pairs.target: sànchǎng shí , yǎ lì shōu zhǐ shōu dé hěnkuài ,
pairs.english: As the meeting ended, Yali packed her papers quickly,
pairs.hanzi: 散场时，雅栗收纸收得很快，

pairs.target: nài lěi què bǎ tā lánxià , qǐng tā zhǐrèn yíchù jiù dìmíng .
pairs.english: but Nerai stopped her to identify an old place name.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾却把她拦下，请她指认一处旧地名。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài pángbiān děng , shǒulǐ niē zhuóxiǎng dàigěi lín yuán de huíxìn .
pairs.english: Tavi waited beside them, holding the reply he wanted to send to Lin Yuan.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在旁边等，手里捏着想带给林沅的回信。

pairs.target: tā hái méiyǒu kěkào de niánfèn , xìn lǐ zhī wèn néngfǒu qǐng jiùzhàn de rén rèn yi rèn chē ké cǎotú ,
pairs.english: He still had no reliable year; his letter only asked whether someone from the old station might recognize the shell sketch.
pairs.hanzi: 他还没有可靠的年份，信里只问能否请旧站的人认一认车壳草图，

pairs.target: bú yuàn bǎ cāi lái de niánshù sāijìnqù .
pairs.english: He didn't want to insert a guessed date.
pairs.hanzi: 不愿把猜来的年数塞进去。

pairs.target: " yào jì ? " nài lěi kànjiàn xìnfēng .
pairs.english: “Posting that?” Nerai noticed the envelope.
pairs.hanzi: “要寄？”奈蕾看见信封。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu . tā zhǐ gěi tā gōngshǔ wài jiējiǎo de shōuxìn guì , shuō jīntiān hái láidejí tóu ;
pairs.english: He nodded. She pointed out the mail counter at the street corner outside the office, saying there was still time today;
pairs.hanzi: 他点头。她指给他公署外街角的收信柜，说今天还来得及投；

pairs.target: qiáo jiě bìng bù tiāntiān zǒu zhè tiáo lù , bié bǎ pǔtōng de xìn quán yā zài yígè rén shēnshàng .
pairs.english: Sister Qiao didn't travel this road every day, so he shouldn't burden one person with all the ordinary mail.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐并不天天走这条路，别把普通的信全压在一个人身上。

pairs.target: mǐlā yǐjīng è le .
pairs.english: Mira was hungry already.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉已经饿了。

pairs.target: tāmen tóu wán xìn , zài jiēkǒu mǎi le sānwǎn miàn , jǐ zhe yìzhāng xiǎozhuō zuòxià .
pairs.english: After posting the letter, they bought three bowls of noodles at the street entrance and squeezed around a little table.
pairs.hanzi: 他们投完信，在街口买了三碗面，挤着一张小桌坐下。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ làjiàng bōkāi , mǐlā què bǎ zìjǐ nà fèn quán bàn jìnqù , chī dào yíbàn cái shēnshǒu zhǎoshuǐ .
pairs.english: Iven pushed his chilli sauce aside, but Mira stirred all hers in and only reached for water halfway through.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把辣酱拨开，米拉却把自己那份全拌进去，吃到一半才伸手找水。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐhòu yào gěi xiūlù de rén huàtú . " tā shuō , " yě yào qù kàn bǔ chuán de dìfāng . "
pairs.english: “I want to draw plans for road crews,” she said. “And see where boats are repaired too.”
pairs.hanzi: “我以后要给修路的人画图。”她说，“也要去看补船的地方。”

pairs.target: yīwén yòng kuàizi zhǐ tā : " xiān bǎ miàn chī wán . nǐ de tú xiànzài quán shì làyóu . "
pairs.english: Iven pointed his chopsticks at her. “Finish your noodles first. Your drawings are all chilli oil now.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文用筷子指她：“先把面吃完。你的图现在全是辣油。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu , fāxiàn tú jiá qíshí hái gē zài dèng shàng , biàn tī le tā yíxià .
pairs.english: She looked down, found the folder still on the bench, and kicked him.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头，发现图夹其实还搁在凳上，便踢了他一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe tì tā bǎ jiāzi nuókāi .
pairs.english: Laughing, Tavi moved it aside for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着替她把夹子挪开。

pairs.target: zhuōzi tàixiǎo , sānzhī wǎn āi dé jìn ,
pairs.english: The table was too small, the three bowls close together;
pairs.hanzi: 桌子太小，三只碗挨得近，

pairs.target: shuí yì dītóu , éqián de yǐngzi jiù luò jìn biérén de tāng lǐ .
pairs.english: whenever anyone lowered their head, the shadow of their brow fell into someone else's soup.
pairs.hanzi: 谁一低头，额前的影子就落进别人的汤里。
